title: Forward repeats that open a bar mid-system
description: Two forward repeats that are not the first bar of a system, which no other scenario had. Bar 3 opens a repeat at an ordinary boundary: the `|:` IS that barline, so its thick stroke stands exactly where the plain barline would and no plain barline is drawn under it. Bar 5 opens a repeat immediately after bar 4's backward repeat — the `:||:` case, where both clusters are real ink and keep their own room. Pins the boundary the layout used to get wrong: the `|:` was placed after the content pad, which triples across the clearance ladder, so at wide clearance the cluster peeled away from the barline it was supposed to be, with a plain barline still drawn behind it.
